messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Error when deploying app
parts:
Jordan,
Is it at all possible that you are running on version 3.2.5 of R?  Our error message about not supporting the latest version has been broken for the past week and unfortunately we are short on engineering this week.  If you are on .5 you can get past this issue by downgrading to 3.2.4.  Sorry about the hassle.
